name: AM-4030
summary: AM-4030 is an analgesic drug which is a cannabinoid receptor agonist. It is a derivative of HU-210 which has been substituted with a 6β-((E)-3-hydroxyprop-1-enyl) group.

pharmacology.text: AM-4030 is an analgesic drug which is a cannabinoid receptor agonist.

summaryZh: AM-4030是一種有機化合物，化學式C27H42O4，屬於一種AM系列大麻素，可看作是HU-210的6β-取代衍生物。

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study the cannabinoid receptors and pain. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是用來研究大麻素受體與疼痛的研究用化合物，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是用来研究大麻素受体与疼痛的研究用化合物，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied in people. Potent synthetic cannabinoids as a class can cause a racing heart, anxiety, confusion, vomiting and, at times, psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體研究過。強效合成大麻素作為一類，可能造成心跳急促、焦慮、混亂、嘔吐，有時還會引發精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体研究过。强效合成大麻素作为一类，可能造成心跳急促、焦虑、混乱、呕吐，有时还会引发精神病。

fact.en: It is a derivative of HU-210, a compound whose HU code stands for the Hebrew University in Jerusalem, where Raphael Mechoulam's laboratory first worked out the structure of THC.
fact.zh: 它是 HU-210 的衍生物，HU 代號指的是耶路撒冷的希伯來大學，Raphael Mechoulam 的實驗室就是在那裡首次解出 THC 的結構。
fact.zhHans: 它是 HU-210 的衍生物，HU 代号指的是耶路撒冷的希伯来大学，Raphael Mechoulam 的实验室就是在那里首次解出 THC 的结构。
